name: ConvoDojo Practice Sparring
purpose: Structured practice environment for conversational skills: persona module strictly separated from coach/feedback module, staged conversations, rubric-grounded feedback as lenses, calibrated pushback via intensity profile (productive challenge as orchestration function, not personality), adversarial stress testing before deployment (multi-agent judging r=0.82), evidence-grounded debriefs, and transfer scenarios for generalization.
representative_examples: MI practice: user rehearses evoking change talk against a persona; coach interrupts on demand with Aimi-style reflection-to-question ratio feedback; intensity escalates 2→4 as proficiency rises.
Pre-deployment stress test: a conflict-de-escalation pattern is run against multiple adversarial personas with cumulative pressure; multi-agent judges (r=0.82 human-aligned) gate deployment.
Transfer scenario: after practicing a workplace conversation in the office context, the user runs the same skill in a family context to test generalization.
failure_hints: If the sparring partner always agrees, sycophancy guard failed — recalibrate the orchestration function.
If the user looks overwhelmed or withdraws, intensity is too high — Reduce_Intensity immediately.
If rubric scores read like a verdict on the person, reframe as evidence-anchored lenses.
If a persona performs below chance or stereotypes, the persona bank needs sanitization (Ma 2025).
source_influences: ConvoDojo (staged sparring, hierarchical state control, rubric feedback)
Han 2026 (auto-coding accuracy as lens, not gospel)

governance.rule: No AtomicOp executes on high-meaning tasks (identity, values, commitments, interpretive closure) without a Human_Empowerment_Boundary check first
